mapper.select:
SELECT PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text FROM REP_PROD_INFO where (P_PROD_ID is null or P_PROD_ID = PROD_ID)
and (PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select T1.PROD_ID prodId, T1.UUID uuid, T2.PROD_NAME prodName, T1.PUB_DATE pubDate, T1.BANK_TRANS_AMT bankTransAmt, T1.ORG_TRANS_AMT orgTransAmt, T1.INVEST_TRANS_AMT investTransAmt, T1.RELATEAMOUNT relateamount, T1.EFFDATE effdate, T1.EFFDELIDATE effdelidate, T1.STATUS status, T1.UPDATE_USER updateUser, T1.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, T1.ERRORMSG errormsg from REP_REL_DEAL T1 left join REP_PROD_INFO T2 on T2.PROD_ID = T1.PROD_ID
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and T1.STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and T1.EFFDATE >= to_date(#{startEffdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.EFFDATE <= to_date(#{endEffdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.EFFDELIDATE >= to_date(#{startEffdelidate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.EFFDELIDATE <= to_date(#{endEffdelidate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select T1.UUID uuid, T1.PROD_ID prodId, T1.BANK_TRANS_AMT bankTransAmt, T1.ORG_TRANS_AMT orgTransAmt, T1.INVEST_TRANS_AMT investTransAmt, T1.RELATEAMOUNT relateamount, T1.EFFDATE effdate, T1.EFFDELIDATE effdelidate from REP_REL_DEAL T1 where T1.UUID = #{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into REP_REL_DEAL (PROD_ID,PUB_DATE,BANK_TRANS_AMT, ORG_TRANS_AMT,INVEST_TRANS_AMT,RELATEAMOUNT, EFFDATE,EFFDELIDATE,CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER,STATUS,UUID) values (#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{pubDate,jdbcType=DATE},#{bankTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{orgTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{investTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{relateamount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{effdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{effdelidate,jdbcType=DATE},#{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},#{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update REP_REL_DEAL set PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PUB_DATE = #{pubDate,jdbcType=DATE}, BANK_TRANS_AMT = #{bankTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, ORG_TRANS_AMT = #{orgTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, INVEST_TRANS_AMT = #{investTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, RELATEAMOUNT = #{relateamount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EFFDATE = #{effdate,jdbcType=DATE}, EFFDELIDATE = #{effdelidate,jdbcType=DATE}, STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, ERRORMSG = #{errormsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where UUID = #{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID FROM REP_PROD_INFO WHERE (P_PROD_ID is null or P_PROD_ID = PROD_ID) and PROD_ID = #{prodId}
select * from REP_REL_DEAL where PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS not in ('D')

select T1.UUID uuid, T1.PROD_ID prodId, T1.BANK_TRANS_AMT bankTransAmt, T1.ORG_TRANS_AMT orgTransAmt, T1.INVEST_TRANS_AMT investTransAmt, T1.RELATEAMOUNT relateamount, T1.EFFDATE effdate, T1.EFFDELIDATE effdelidate from REP_REL_DEAL T1 where T1.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and T1.EFFDATE = #{effdate,jdbcType=DATE} and T1.EFFDELIDATE = #{effdelidate,jdbcType=DATE}
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO REP_REL_DEAL RRD USING ( SELECT #{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UUID, #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{pubDate,jdbcType=DATE} PUB_DATE, #{bankTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} BANK_TRANS_AMT, #{orgTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ORG_TRANS_AMT, #{investTransAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} INVEST_TRANS_AMT, #{relateamount,jdbcType=VARCHAR} RELATEAMOUNT, #{effdate,jdbcType=DATE} EFFDATE, #{effdelidate,jdbcType=DATE} EFFDELIDATE, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON(RRD.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID and RRD.EFFDATE = TEMP.EFFDATE and RRD.EFFDELIDATE = TEMP.EFFDELIDATE and RRD.STATUS = 'E' )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RRD.PUB_DATE = TEMP.PUB_DATE, RRD.BANK_TRANS_AMT = TEMP.BANK_TRANS_AMT, RRD.ORG_TRANS_AMT = TEMP.ORG_TRANS_AMT, RRD.INVEST_TRANS_AMT = TEMP.INVEST_TRANS_AMT, RRD.RELATEAMOUNT = TEMP.RELATEAMOUNT, RRD.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, RRD.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RRD.ERRORMSG = ''
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(UUID,PROD_ID,PUB_DATE,BANK_TRANS_AMT, ORG_TRANS_AMT,INVEST_TRANS_AMT,RELATEAMOUNT, EFFDATE,EFFDELIDATE,CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER,STATUS) VALUES(TEMP.UUID,TEMP.PROD_ID,TEMP.PUB_DATE,TEMP.BANK_TRANS_AMT, TEMP.ORG_TRANS_AMT,TEMP.INVEST_TRANS_AMT,TEMP.RELATEAMOUNT, TEMP.EFFDATE,TEMP.EFFDELIDATE,TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT,TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.STATUS)
